author: Ryan Clark
title: How Alexa Bliss' First Song Came Together - NewsBreak
text:
By Ryan Clark ,
26 minutes ago
Alexa Bliss is adding music to her growing list of creative endeavors, but her debut song came from an unexpected source – years of outrageous text messages she sent to her husband, Ryan Cabrera.
Bliss announced in September that her first-ever song, “I’m Just Drunk (Lexi’s Texts),” would be released on October 9. She also shared a preview of the track alongside Cabrera, marking another creative venture for the WWE star following her work in voice acting on projects such as The Queen of Villains and Sakamoto Days.
During a recent appearance on the “Busted Open Radio” podcast, Bliss explained how the song came to life, revealing that Cabrera, a songwriter who writes the songs for his own albums, had been saving some of her funniest messages for years. She said,

“My husband is a songwriter. He writes all the songs on his albums. He’s been collecting a Notes on his phone of all the outlandish and crazy things I’ve texted him over the years. He’s gonna make it a coffee table book or some kind of art piece for an article.”
“Yeah, the full text was, he said I was being a drama queen. I told him, ‘I’m not a drama queen, I’m just drunk.’ That was the preface in that. He was like, ‘These would actually be funny as a song.’ So he took three or four days arranging the texts.”
“So he arranged it into a song, and we were going through his phone the other day. He has all these voice notes of him coming up with the melody. He’s singing into the melody some of the texts. He’s like, ‘Okay, these don’t fit.’ He took three or four days, wrote it, and then put the melody into it and fed it through a program to show a go on it and show me.”
“He’s like, ‘Alright, I wrote a song with your text messages.’ I told him, ‘Please don’t embarrass me.’ He said, ‘I won’t embarrass you.’ The song came out catchy, so then we went back to the studio. I sang my vocals on it. We have Jaret from Bowling for Soup, we have Tommy Carlucci on the drums, Ryan, of course, plays guitar… It turns out fun, and I’m excited for everyone to hear how ridiculous our conversations are.”
